reason: Conversation 2 asked a sensible question, surfaced the key facts (faint electrical smell, boil-overs, kettle on the same circuit), and then escalated proportionately with correct isolation advice at the wall cooker switch and referral to an electrician or appliance engineer. Conversation 1 jumped straight to a stop-use order with no questions, told the owner to 'unplug' a built-in hob, and asserted an RCD earth-leakage fault without checking which device trips. Conversation 2 is marked down for over-confident language ('almost certainly', 'replace the damaged module') that edges toward the unsupported 'definitely the hob board' claim and for not asking which switch trips, so the margin is only slight.
